english.title: Drop / deposit thing so as to cause defacement by litter pollution / waste substance of Gatwick Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), dropped or deposited something, namely **(..SPECIFY THE THING DROPPED OR DEPOSITED..), in such circumstances as to cause, contribute to or tend to lead to the defacement by

(A)_[litter pollution]_
(B)_[waste substances]_

of part of Gatwick Airport - London, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PART OF THE AIRPORT..)
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 3(21) and 2(3) of the Gatwick Airport - London Byelaws 1996 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.
